verses.original: Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν Ταῦτα καὶ ἐπάρας αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶπεν Πάτερ ἡ ὥρα ἐλήλυθεν δόξασόν σου τὸν Υἱόν ἵνα ὁ Υἱὸς δοξάσῃ σέ
verses.transliteration: Iēsous elalēsen Tauta kai eparas autou tous ophthalmous eis ton ouranon eipen Pater hē hōra elēlythen doxason sou ton Huion hina ho Huios doxasē se
verses.literal: [When] Jesus had spoken these things - He lifted up His - eyes to - heaven [and] said Father the hour has come Glorify Your - Son that [Your] Son may glorify You

verses.original: καθὼς ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν πάσης σαρκός ἵνα δώσῃ αὐτοῖς αἰώνιον ζωὴν πᾶν ὃ δέδωκας αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kathōs edōkas autō exousian pasēs sarkos hina dōsē autois aiōnion zōēn pan ho dedōkas autō
verses.literal: For You granted Him authority over all people so that He may give - eternal life [to] all those You have given Him

verses.original: δέ αὕτη ἐστιν αἰώνιος ἡ ζωὴ ἵνα γινώσκωσιν σὲ τὸν μόνον ἀληθινὸν Θεὸν καὶ Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν ὃν ἀπέστειλας
verses.transliteration: de hautē estin aiōnios hē zōē hina ginōskōsin se ton monon alēthinon Theon kai Iēsoun Christon hon apesteilas
verses.literal: Now this is eternal - life that they may know You the only true God and Jesus Christ whom You have sent

verses.original: ἐγώ ἐδόξασα σε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τελειώσας τὸ ἔργον ὃ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ποιήσω
verses.transliteration: egō edoxasa se epi tēs gēs teleiōsas to ergon ho dedōkas moi hina poiēsō
verses.literal: I have glorified You on - earth by accomplishing the work - You gave Me to do

verses.original: καὶ νῦν Πάτερ σύ δόξασόν με παρὰ σεαυτῷ τῇ δόξῃ ᾗ εἶχον παρὰ σοί πρὸ τὸν κόσμον τοῦ εἶναι
verses.transliteration: kai nyn Pater sy doxason me para seautō tē doxē hē eichon para soi pro ton kosmon tou einai
verses.literal: And now Father - glorify Me in Your presence with the glory - I had with You before the world - existed

verses.original: Ἐφανέρωσά σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις οὓς ἔδωκάς μοι ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἦσαν σοὶ ἔδωκας αὐτοὺς κἀμοὶ καὶ τετήρηκαν σου τὸν λόγον
verses.transliteration: Ephanerōsa sou to onoma tois anthrōpois hous edōkas moi ek tou kosmou ēsan soi edōkas autous kamoi kai tetērēkan sou ton logon
verses.literal: I have revealed Your - name to those . . . . . . You have given Me out of the world They were Yours You gave them to Me and they have kept Your - word

verses.original: νῦν ἔγνωκαν ὅτι πάντα ὅσα δέδωκάς μοι εἰσιν παρὰ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: nyn egnōkan hoti panta hosa dedōkas moi eisin para sou
verses.literal: Now they know that everything . . . You have given Me comes from You

verses.original: ὅτι δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἔδωκάς μοι καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἔγνωσαν ἀληθῶς ὅτι ἐξῆλθον παρὰ σοῦ καὶ ἐπίστευσαν ὅτι σύ ἀπέστειλας με
verses.transliteration: hoti dedōka autois ta rhēmata ha edōkas moi kai autoi elabon kai egnōsan alēthōs hoti exēlthon para sou kai episteusan hoti sy apesteilas me
verses.literal: For I have given them the words - You gave Me and they have received [them] - They knew with certainty that I came from You and they believed that You sent Me

verses.original: Ἐγὼ ἐρωτῶ περὶ αὐτῶν οὐ ἐρωτῶ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι εἰσιν σοί
verses.transliteration: Egō erōtō peri autōn ou erōtō peri tou kosmou alla peri hōn dedōkas moi hoti eisin soi
verses.literal: I ask on their behalf vvv I do not ask on behalf of the world but on behalf of those You have given Me for they are Yours

verses.original: καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐμὰ ἐστιν σά καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς δεδόξασμαι
verses.transliteration: kai panta ta ema estin sa kai ta sa ema kai en autois dedoxasmai
verses.literal: - All - I have is Yours and [all] You have [is] Mine and in them I have been glorified

verses.original: καὶ εἰμὶ οὐκέτι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ καὶ αὐτοὶ εἰσίν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ κἀγὼ ἔρχομαι πρὸς σὲ ἅγιε Πάτερ τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν σου τῷ ὀνόματί ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς
verses.transliteration: kai eimi ouketi en tō kosmō kai autoi eisin en tō kosmō kagō erchomai pros se hagie Pater tērēson autous en sou tō onomati hō dedōkas moi hina ōsin hen kathōs hēmeis
verses.literal: - I will no longer be . . . in the world but they are in the world and I am coming to You Holy Father protect them by Your - name [the name] You gave Me so that they may be one as We [are one]

verses.original: ὅτε ἤμην μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν καὶ ἐφύλαξα αὐτοὺς ἐν σου τῷ ὀνόματί ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: hote ēmēn met’ autōn egō etēroun kai ephylaxa autous en sou tō onomati hō dedōkas moi kai oudeis ex autōn apōleto ei mē ho huios tēs apōleias hina hē graphē plērōthē
verses.literal: While I was with them I protected and preserved them by Your - name [the name] You gave Me - Not one of them has been lost except . . . the son - of destruction so that the Scripture would be fulfilled

verses.original: δὲ Νῦν ἔρχομαι πρὸς σὲ καὶ λαλῶ ταῦτα ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν ἐμὴν τὴν χαρὰν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Nyn erchomai pros se kai lalō tauta en tō kosmō hina echōsin tēn emēn tēn charan peplērōmenēn en heautois
verses.literal: But now I am coming to You and I am saying these things [while I am] in the world so that they may have - My - joy fulfilled within them

verses.original: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς σου τὸν λόγον καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς ὅτι εἰσὶν οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ εἰμὶ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: egō dedōka autois sou ton logon kai ho kosmos emisēsen autous hoti eisin ouk ek tou kosmou kathōs egō eimi ouk ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: I have given them Your - word and the world has hated them For they are not of the world just as I am not of the world

verses.original: Οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλ’ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ
verses.transliteration: Ouk erōtō hina arēs autous ek tou kosmou all’ hina tērēsēs autous ek tou ponērou
verses.literal: vvv I am not asking that You take them out of the world but that You keep them from the evil [one]

verses.original: εἰσὶν οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ εἰμὶ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: eisin ouk ek tou kosmou kathōs egō eimi ouk ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: They are not of the world just as I am not of the world

verses.original: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ ὁ σὸς ὁ λόγος ἐστιν ἀλήθειά
verses.transliteration: hagiason autous en tē alētheia ho sos ho logos estin alētheia
verses.literal: Sanctify them by the truth - Your - word is truth

verses.original: καθὼς ἀπέστειλας ἐμὲ εἰς τὸν κόσμον κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: kathōs apesteilas eme eis ton kosmon kagō apesteila autous eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: As You sent Me into the world I {have} also sent them into the world

verses.original: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν ἵνα αὐτοὶ καὶ ὦσιν ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai hyper autōn egō hagiazō emauton hina autoi kai ōsin hēgiasmenoi en alētheia
verses.literal: - For them I sanctify Myself so that they too may be sanctified by [the] truth

verses.original: δὲ Οὐ ἐρωτῶ περὶ τούτων μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ διὰ αὐτῶν τοῦ λόγου
verses.transliteration: de Ou erōtō peri toutōn monon alla kai peri tōn pisteuontōn eis eme dia autōn tou logou
verses.literal: - vvv I am not asking on behalf of them alone but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their - message

verses.original: ἵνα πάντες ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς σύ πάτερ ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν σοί ἵνα αὐτοὶ καὶ ὦσιν ἐν ἡμῖν ἵνα ὁ κόσμος πιστεύῃ ὅτι σύ ἀπέστειλας με
verses.transliteration: hina pantes ōsin hen kathōs sy pater en emoi kagō en soi hina autoi kai ōsin en hēmin hina ho kosmos pisteuē hoti sy apesteilas me
verses.literal: that all of them may be one as You Father [are] in Me and I [am] in You [May] they also be in Us so that the world may believe that You sent Me

verses.original: Κἀγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς ἕν
verses.transliteration: Kagō dedōka autois tēn doxan hēn dedōkas moi hina ōsin hen kathōs hēmeis hen
verses.literal: I have given them the glory - You gave Me so that they may be one as We [are] one

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ σὺ ἐν ἐμοί ἵνα ὦσιν τετελειωμένοι εἰς ἕν ἵνα ὁ κόσμος γινώσκῃ ὅτι σύ ἀπέστειλας με καὶ ἠγάπησας αὐτοὺς καθὼς ἠγάπησας ἐμὲ
verses.transliteration: egō en autois kai sy en emoi hina ōsin teteleiōmenoi eis hen hina ho kosmos ginōskē hoti sy apesteilas me kai ēgapēsas autous kathōs ēgapēsas eme
verses.literal: I in them and You in Me that they may be perfectly - united so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me

verses.original: Πάτερ θέλω ἵνα ὃ δέδωκάς μοι κἀκεῖνοι ὦσιν μετ’ ἐμοῦ ὅπου ἐγὼ εἰμὶ ἵνα θεωρῶσιν τὴν ἐμὴν τὴν δόξαν ἣν δέδωκάς μοι ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Pater thelō hina ho dedōkas moi kakeinoi ōsin met’ emou hopou egō eimi hina theōrōsin tēn emēn tēn doxan hēn dedōkas moi hoti ēgapēsas me pro katabolēs kosmou
verses.literal: Father I want - [those] You have given Me - to be with Me where I am that they may see - [the] - glory - You gave Me because You loved Me before [the] foundation of [the] world

verses.original: δίκαιε Πάτερ καὶ ὁ κόσμος οὐκ ἔγνω σε δέ ἐγὼ ἔγνων σε καὶ οὗτοι ἔγνωσαν ὅτι σύ ἀπέστειλας με
verses.transliteration: dikaie Pater kai ho kosmos ouk egnō se de egō egnōn se kai houtoi egnōsan hoti sy apesteilas me
verses.literal: Righteous Father although the world {has} not known You - I know You and [they] know that You sent Me

verses.original: καὶ ἐγνώρισα σου τὸ ὄνομά αὐτοῖς καὶ γνωρίσω ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ἣν ἠγάπησάς με ᾖ ἐν αὐτοῖς κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egnōrisa sou to onoma autois kai gnōrisō hina hē agapē hēn ēgapēsas me ē en autois kagō en autois
verses.literal: And I have made Your - name {known} to them and will continue to make [it] known so that the love You have for . . . Me may be in them and I in them
